name: 1235-unit-alert
task: Listen: an enemy militia just hit one of your militia at the dock (a server command).
ask: #1235: Did you hear a goat horn and see the chat line 'Your units are under attack'? Is the horn too loud, too quiet or good?

name: 1235-building-alert
task: Listen: an enemy militia just hit your barracks (a server command).
ask: #1235: Did you hear a town bell and see the chat line 'Your buildings are under attack'? Is the bell too loud, too quiet or good?

name: 1235-flare
task: Press 4 (the Game menu item in the hotbar), right click, and click 'Flare'. Look at a place on the ground first: the flare goes there.
ask: #1235: Did you hear the bell of the flare, and is the column easy to see in the day?
